title: Aralo expansion plan (format v0)
description: What a shell's injector does for one expansion: a list of steps, run in order. The plan says what reaches the document; the shell picks how (typing or paste) per app. Format v0 is pre-release and may change without a migration.
$comment: Mirrors `ExpansionPlan`, `Step` and `Key` in crates/aralo-template/src/plan.rs. Those types have no serde derive today: on macOS a plan crosses the bridge as the UniFFI enum `PlanStep` (crates/aralo-ffi/src/lib.rs), not as JSON. This schema fixes the JSON form for tools, tests and future shells: each step is an object tagged by `type`, with variant and field names in snake_case. When this file and the Rust types disagree on the steps or their fields, the Rust code wins; please report it.

steps.description: The steps, in the order the injector runs them. An empty list is a valid plan that does nothing.

delete.description: `Step::Delete`. Press Backspace `count` times. This removes the abbreviation that already reached the document.

insertText.description: `Step::InsertText`. Insert plain text. May contain newlines.

insertRich.description: `Step::InsertRich`. Insert rich text, with the plain form for apps that refuse it. Planned for v1; nothing produces this step today.

keyPress.description: `Step::KeyPress`. Press a key the target app should see as a key, not as text. Used to put back a Return or Tab that triggered the expansion.

delay.description: `Step::Delay`. Wait `millis` milliseconds. For per-app compatibility rules; nothing produces this step today.

moveCursor.description: `Step::MoveCursor`. Move the cursor left by `graphemes` user-perceived characters, selecting on the way if `select`. For the `{{cursor}}` placeholder; nothing produces this step today.
